issue.title: Name toobig_split agents with the `@` template suffix instead of a path hash
issue.description: Agents proposed by the `toobig_split` chop are named `split_file.<full_dotted_module>.@` (rendered as `<clan>.split_file.<module>.0`) instead of `split_file.<truncated_module>.<8-hex-hash>`, which requires SASE to support one `@` template marker in a chop proposal's `clan` and another in its `agent_name`.

issue.title: Allow one template marker in each of a chop proposal's clan and member
issue.description: "Phase 1 - Core: allow one marker in each of clan and member" section: relax `validate_clan_member_identity` in the sase-core chop validator so a composed clan-member name may carry one `@` from the clan template and one from the member template, keeping the per-component "at most one marker" rule, and update the Rust unit tests that pin the old `ambiguous_agent_name_template` behavior.

issue.title: Allocate chop member template tokens inside the concrete clan
issue.description: "Phase 2 - Planner: allocate member tokens inside the concrete clan" section: teach `_plan_clan_group` in `src/sase/axe/chop_proposals.py` to render the clan token first and then allocate each templated member name within the concrete clan on a trial reservation index, add regression tests, and document the two-marker rule in `docs/axe.md`.

issue.title: Emit `split_file.<full_module>.@` member names from the toobig_split chop
issue.description: "Phase 3 - Chop: emit split_file.<module>.@ names" section: change `_agent_name` in the bugyi-chops `toobig_split` module to drop the path digest and the 48-character slug truncation and end the member name with `.@`, update its tests, and bump the `sase` floor to the release that contains the planner change.
